tasks.label: Launchpad audit: list changed screenshots
tasks.command: for f in 00-baseline/*.png; do n=$(basename "$f"); a=$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | awk '{print $1}'); b=$(shasum -a 256 "99-final-state/$n" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); [ "$a" != "$b" ] && echo "$n"; done
tasks.detail: Diffs every baseline vs 99-final-state PNG pair via shasum and prints filenames that changed. Use this list to refresh the CHANGED manifest in compare.html.

tasks.label: Launchpad audit: open compare.html
tasks.detail: Opens screenshots/launchpad-audit/compare.html in the default browser for visual baseline vs final-state comparison.
